title: Across-span of arbitrary finite bonds on base 16
claim: For every finite support size m, every bond of that size in base 16 has across-span bounded uniformly in the along-counts. The proof supplies an explicit recursive bound.
standard_statement: For the two translated not-all-equal triples of base 16 on the integers squared, bound the across diameter of a minimal non-shattered finite set in terms of its cardinality, regardless of the longitudinal positions.
prior_work: FOLD gives the constrained flip presentation. ACROSS-FOLD proves a sharp lower bound for one along-count and one target. No existing local proof located for arbitrary supports. Classical non-mixing shapes are a comparator; the argument here is direct. No field novelty claimed.

validation.status: Proved by construction and induction; separate mathematical reading and finite checks passed.
validation.independence: Community peer review absent. The agent responsible for the separate base 16 construction reviewed the proof independently; the direct finite checker is by this proof’s author.
validation.novelty: candidate-local-delta for the unrestricted base 16 support quantifier; no field novelty claim

remaining_obligations: The sharp linear lower bound on unrestricted supports remains open.
foundation_claim_scope: All finite bond supports of the supplied base 16. No native-source claim, dimensional classification or assertion of the sharp rate.
